label: Test by Rivals of the fourteen stage-two attribute premises surv for Whatever is composed of m (1)
note: Tests the selected premise in the following setting. Same ComposedOfMatterAndForm and Composite predicates and essenceOf/esseOf maps; two beings, one respect, two principles. Control.differenceWithoutComposition in Control.Certificate. Other four premises of FirstMoverSimple.firstMoverSimple hold: no body moves unless moved, the first unmoved mover is the first being, composites are posterior to components, every composite has a component other than itself. Its conclusion fails at the clause that the first mover's esse is not other than its essence.
